entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 32, designated by 𝔓32, is an early copy of a partial text of the New Testament in Greek. A papyrus manuscript of the Epistle to Titus, it contains only Titus 1:11-15; 2:3-8. On the basis of paleography, the manuscript has been assigned a date around A.D. 200.
